name.zh: 爱德怀斯结束休假出发
name.en: Edelweiss Ends Her Vacation and Departs

periods.summary: After feeding Stella's group breakfast and seeing them off, Edelweiss finds that Fu Xiaoli has already left, saying she lost the summit challenge. Edelweiss reflects that watching Stella and Ikki grow made her short vacation unexpectedly enjoyable, but Or-Gaule has damaged the world's gears and Tsukikage's nightmare may soon begin. She raises a previously fallen photograph of her old Japanese master and tells him she is leaving.
periods.cause: The Or-Gaule crisis and the larger future war mean Edelweiss can no longer remain on vacation.
periods.process: She notes Xiaoli's departure, feels the quiet of the house, thinks about the young generation, drinks tea, and formally pays respects to her master before departing.
periods.outcome: Edelweiss returns to action beyond Edelberg, linking the Vermillion arc to the larger world collapse plot.
periods.significance: Closes the training arc and signals that global-level powers are beginning to move in response to Or-Gaule.
